name: @goal/api-client
description: Typed client for goald's HTTP API (contracts/api/openapi.yaml): openapi-fetch over generated types, errors as Problem, and the event stream subscription

scripts.check:gen: openapi-typescript ../../contracts/api/openapi.yaml --default-non-nullable=false --output .schema.check.ts && node --eval "const fs=require('node:fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('.schema.check.ts','utf8');fs.rmSync('.schema.check.ts');if(a!==fs.readFileSync('src/schema.gen.ts','utf8')){console.error('src/schema.gen.ts is stale: run task api:gen');process.exit(1)}"
